title: Cover Codex approval capture races, read-only refusals and Windows junctions
outcome: Behavioral coverage exercises refusal after a capture changes, read-only refusal without a notice, and Windows junction escape.
acceptance: A controlled change to the captured turn/runtime/sandbox between path resolution and final admission produces the native decline with no fabricated System notice or pending approval card.
A read-only delegation encountering an explicit sandbox refusal declines without a new refusal notice, preserving the read-only owner.
A Windows-local junction or symlink escape is refused through the real host decision path; the test uses repository-local fixtures and makes no external network access.
